product_updates.title: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
product_updates.content: The U.S. VC firm still has more than 55% of its previous $650 million India fund available for deployment.

product_updates.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
product_updates.content: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems.

product_updates.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to 1 billion users
product_updates.content: Google also shared numbers of how people are actually using the chatbot, with 63% of Gemini users talking directly to the assistant using the voice feature. Plus, Gemini now generates more than 150 million images every day, according to Google.

product_updates.title: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI’s longtime COO, is leaving to ‘start something new’
product_updates.content: One of OpenAI's longest-serving executives is headed out the door, although the longtime COO told staff that he was "excited to help you all advance the mission from a different vantage point."

product_updates.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
product_updates.content: River AI, a startup founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, has a fascinating vision for personal agents and secured $1.1 billion out of the gate.

product_updates.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
product_updates.content: For more than 150 years, the Riemann hypothesis has stood as one of the major unsolved problems in mathematics. Anthropic hasn't solved it — but the company's models made more progress than you might expect.

product_updates.title: Spotify will label ‘AI Persona’ profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
product_updates.content: Spotify is introducing “AI Persona” labels for artist profiles that represent AI-generated identities and will exclude their music from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default.

product_updates.title: Anthropic says it will watermark text generated by its AI models
product_updates.content: Anthropic will extend support for watermarking AI generations for older models as well.
